_comment: Every backbone used to annotate the corpus, with the read-out that defines its cell. Identical text budget and truncation across all cells, so a cell differs from another only in model, prompt and read-out.

shared_configuration.sampling: none; a single forward pass, no generation

read_outs.first_token: softmax over the logits of the leading token of each label at the answer position
read_outs.full_string: summed log-probabilities of all label tokens, softmax over the four sums; not length-normalised

prompts.P1: the deployed prompt: direction of the exposure-outcome association, one word
prompts.P2: P1 with explicit label definitions in the system prompt (NULL = the abstract directly reports no association for the named pair; UNCLEAR = the pair is absent or its direction cannot be determined)

D_second.note: the second pipeline of the cross-pipeline sensitivity analysis

M_third.note: the third annotation family; requires text_full.json, not the records snapshot, which carries no abstracts

encoder.pooling: mean over title and abstract, L2-normalised

duplicate_key_rule: Where an association key occurs more than once in a re-executed cell, the first occurrence in sorted file order is used. The last-occurrence rule disagrees on 476 of 33,737 duplicated keys and yields the same event count (78).
